title.rendered: Railroad Crossing Maintenance to Temporarily Close West King Street and Kinlaw Road

content.rendered:
Key Points

Motorists are advised of upcoming temporary road closures and detours associated with railroad crossing maintenance on W. King Street and Kinlaw Road. The crossings will be closed to all traffic, including vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians, during the closures.

Motorists are encouraged to plan ahead, allow additional travel time, and follow posted detour signs while railroad crossing maintenance is underway. Drivers should use caution and obey all posted signs when traveling near the work areas.

title.rendered: Florida East Coast Railway to Temporarily Close Race Track Road Railroad for Maintenance

content.rendered:
Closure scheduled Feb. 7-10, 2026

Florida East Coast Railway will temporarily close the railroad crossing on Race Track Road near the U.S. 1 intersection beginning at 8 p.m. Saturday, Feb. 7, to conduct scheduled grade crossing maintenance. The closure is expected to last three days, reopening at 8 p.m. Tuesday, Feb 10, weather permitting. During this time, vehicles, bicycles, and pedestrians will not be able to cross the railroad tracks.

The work and closure are being managed by Florida East Coast Railway, which is responsible for maintenance of this railroad crossing. St. Johns County is sharing information to keep residents informed and help minimize travel impacts.
